models.title: Time-series plots
models.summary: Compare selected series over their actual observed sample.
models.label: Descriptive

models.title: Correlation and rolling correlation
models.summary: Describe contemporaneous co-movement and its change across trailing windows.
models.label: Descriptive

models.title: Country comparison and ranking
models.summary: Rank country averages or latest observations over explicitly recorded samples.
models.label: Descriptive

models.title: Unit-root and stationarity tests
models.summary: Compare ADF and Phillips-Perron unit-root tests with the KPSS stationarity test.
models.label: Descriptive

models.title: Linear regression
models.summary: Estimate a conditional linear association with HAC or HC1 uncertainty.
models.label: Association, not causation

models.title: Autoregressive distributed lag regression
models.summary: Estimate lagged responses and show their equivalent error-correction parameterisation.
models.label: Association, not causation

models.title: Rolling and recursive regression
models.summary: Track coefficient estimates in trailing windows or an expanding historical sample.
models.label: Association, not causation

models.title: Granger predictive-content test
models.summary: Test whether lagged values of one series help predict another, conditional on its own lags.
models.label: Descriptive

models.title: Hodrick-Prescott filter
models.summary: Separate a smooth trend from a cycle using an explicit smoothing penalty.
models.label: Descriptive

models.title: Hamilton regression filter
models.summary: Define the cycle as the error in a long-horizon projection on past observations.
models.label: Descriptive

models.title: Vector autoregression
models.summary: Estimate joint dynamics and, with recursive assumptions, responses to a chosen shock.
models.label: Association, not causation

models.title: Recursive identification
models.summary: Identify ordered shocks with Cholesky restrictions and explicit shock units.
models.label: Model-based scenario, not a forecast

models.title: Local projections
models.summary: Estimate a separate response at each horizon with explicit controls and samples.
models.label: Conditional association, unless an identified shock is supplied

models.title: Historical decomposition
models.summary: Account for past movements under an explicitly ordered stable recursive VAR.
models.label: Model-based accounting of the past under the recursive identification, not evidence of what caused each movement.

models.title: Reusable identified shock
models.summary: Expose dated orthogonalised residuals from a first-stage recursive VAR.
models.label: Generated shock; conditional on the stated recursive identification

models.title: Common-shock country comparison
models.summary: Reuse one identified shock in country-specific LPs and show actual samples.
models.label: Conditional association, unless an identified shock is supplied

models.title: Panel fixed effects
models.summary: Pooled within-country associations beside country OLS, with robust panel inference.
models.label: Conditional pooled association

models.title: Panel local projections
models.summary: Pool lag-augmented responses to a common or country-specific impulse.
models.label: Conditional pooled association

models.title: Bayesian VAR · Minnesota prior
models.summary: Conjugate shrinkage with seeded posterior bands and a matched OLS comparison.
models.label: Model-based scenario, not a forecast

models.title: ARIMA / SARIMA
models.summary: SARIMAX forecasts, explicit ADF/KPSS differencing and AICc order search.
models.label: Forecast

models.title: VAR / BVAR forecasts
models.summary: Iterated forecasts with re-estimated bootstrap or posterior predictive uncertainty.
models.label: Forecast

models.title: Expanding-window evaluation
models.summary: RW, AR(BIC), ARIMA and BVAR, paired errors and DM/HLN comparisons.
models.label: Forecast evaluation

models.title: Cointegration tests
models.summary: Two Engle–Granger normalisations and Johansen rank tests on levels.
models.label: Long-run association; not causation

models.title: Vector error-correction model
models.summary: User-chosen rank, normalised long-run relations and rank-fixed bootstrap responses.
models.label: Long-run association; not causation

models.title: Structural-break diagnostics
models.summary: Chow, 15%-trimmed sup-F, recursive CUSUM and CUSUM-of-squares for a host equation.
models.label: Parameter stability diagnostic; not causation
